newsitem.title: UK: Britain braced for IRA bombing campaign - report.
newsitem.headline: Britain braced for IRA bombing campaign - report.

text.p: Security forces are on alert throughout Britain amid fears of a new bombing campaign by the Irish Republican Army, the Independent newspaper said on Saturday.
It said vigilance had been stepped up at key sites such as the City financial district and the riverside Canary Wharf complex, both in London, and at military installations across the country.
"Senior politicians in Northern Ireland and at Westminster have been warned they could be assassination targets," it said.
Security had also been tightened at potential targets in Northern Ireland, including at Aldergrove Airport near Belfast.

The IRA has carried out several bombings on the British mainland since it abandoned a 17-month truce last February, but has so far launched only one attack in Northern Ireland, on Britain's main army base.
